text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was the day of the fan meeting
planned by Smart Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This day is finally here!
I'm gonna hype everyone up with my baton twirling~!
Let's do this☆
choice_data_list: You're bursting with fighting spirit, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I practiced just for this day!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Like posting videos on social media
of attempting difficult tricks!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone cheered for me, you know?
That encouragement helped me work hard in practice too♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer!
I'm off to rehearsal... right no—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Um...
Wait, hold on a second...!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Falco's baton is gooo~ne!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Why~!?
I'm positive I had it when I left the dorm!?
choice_data_list: Didn't something happen before you met up with me at the venue!?
Didn't something happen before we met up at the venue!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Um, um, I arrived at the station,
waited for the train... and then, an elderly lady holding heavy-looking luggage... Ah!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Did I leave my bags on the floor
when I went to help...!?
Oh no, that place is pretty far from here—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wha... WHAAAT!?
Does this mean...!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Look at this! A fan found
Falco's baton for me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the smartphone screen is an Umatter direct message addressed to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was a message sent along with a picture of a baton:
"Could this baton happen to belong to Falco-san?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"You were worried it was the same baton from the practice video!
Oh, thank goodness...!"
choice_data_list: But if I go get it, it'll take time...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're right! What do we do... huh?
"I'll find a way to deliver it!"...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, I couldn't possibly ask the fans to go that far... Huh?
'I'll try asking everyone else too'...!?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Could someone please deliver this baton
to Falco's venue?!
I have an urgent errand I can't miss...!"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: "Wait, that's the stuff for today's event! I can make it! Where should we meet up?"

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"It's far from the station, so going by car will be faster!
I can drive if you like, we'll definitely make it in time!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Hang in there, everyone!" "If there's anything I can do, let me know!"—
Cheering fans on social media were doing their best to pass along the baton.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Everyone... went this far for me...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's Falco's baton~!
Thank goodness...! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing!
After all, Falco-chan worked so hard during practice.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... I'm so sorry. To think my fans
have to look after me this much...!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: No, please don't worry about it!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: "Because you always give me so much energy."

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"Even the other day, despite being exhausted after a race,
she gladly signed autographs!
She always treats everyone with a smile, no matter what."

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
If it's for Falco-san,
I'll go anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! Falco-chan always puts a smile on my face,
so today I'm returning the favor!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Ghhh.
Everyone...!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Falco is the happiest
umadol in the whole wide world~!
choice_data_list: So you're loved by the fans, huh.
So you're loved by the fans, aren't you?
Let's hype up the stage to show our gratitude!
How about trying a big move for everyone's sake?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Falco is the happiest
umadol in the whole wide world~!
choice_data_list: So you're loved by the fans, huh.
So you're loved by the fans, aren't you?
Let's hype up the stage to show our gratitude!
How about trying a big move for everyone's sake?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah! Ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Smart Falcon put on a dazzling
baton twirling performance on stage!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, everyone~! ...Um, you know,
there's something Falco wants to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I love you all! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
After all, this is the baton everyone passed to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Smart Falcon put on a dazzling
baton twirling performance on stage!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
How magnificent...! I'm so glad I came~!
Amazing~! You worked so hard, Falco!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Not yet, we're gonna hype things up way mo~re!
So keep following Falco☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A signature move...! Love it!!
I'm gonna make this the best fan meeting ever!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward,
she stood on stage with her baton—

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: I-Incredible...! She's twirling the baton while dancing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I was able to do my best thanks to everyone☆
Please keep cheering for Falco, okay~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Spin right here, and—
H-Huh... Where's the baton~?!"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
A-Above you!
Falco-chan, look out~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Eep!?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Don't worry, don't worry!
Shake it off and let's try the next one!
